findings.current: Thanks to her, he had spent more than half the day trapped in Jin Hayeon’s room.
findings.defect: The duration is reduced from more than a day and a half to more than half a day.
findings.rationale: 하루 반나절 means one full day plus half a day, not half a day.
findings.replacement: Thanks to her, he had spent more than a day and a half trapped in Jin Hayeon’s room.
findings.source: 덕분에 하루 반나절 이상을 진하연의 방에 갇혀 지내는 신세가 됐다.

findings.current: She put her feet up on the chair and sat cross-legged, leaving the desk legs completely out of reach of his tiny body.
findings.defect: The draft says the desk legs became unreachable, but Hayeon is pulling her own feet out of the kitten’s reach.
findings.rationale: The preceding attempts target her feet, and 발을 올려 describes Hayeon lifting those feet onto the chair.
findings.replacement: She pulled her feet up onto the chair and sat cross-legged, putting them completely out of reach of his tiny body.
findings.source: 의자에 발을 올려 책상다리로 앉아 버리고 나니 이 조그마한 몸으로는 결코 닿을 수 없게 되었다.

findings.current: No, there were two of them now, so I supposed I should give them names.
findings.defect: Taekyung decides to distinguish the two cats by calling them by name, not to assign them new names.
findings.rationale: 이름을 불러 주다 means to call someone by name; the next sentence immediately identifies Yeoreum by her existing name.
findings.replacement: No, there were two of them now, so I supposed I should call them by their names.
findings.source: 아니 이제 두 마리니까 이름을 불러 줘야겠구나.

findings.current: The Security Team members, who had been sitting close together and writing their statements, jumped in surprise.
findings.defect: “Statements” mischaracterizes 소견서, which are written opinions or assessments rather than factual or witness statements.
findings.rationale: 소견서 denotes documents recording the members’ judgments or opinions about the target.
findings.replacement: The Security Team members, who had been sitting close together and writing their assessments, jumped in surprise.
findings.source: 옹기종기 모여 앉아 소견서를 쓰고 있던 보안팀원들이 화들짝 놀랐다.

findings.current: Our Yeoreum’s having a real moment of clarity.
findings.defect: The generic wording removes the crude slang and the joke that frames Yeoreum’s dazed shame as post-nut clarity.
findings.rationale: 현자 타임 is colloquial sexual slang for the deflated, lucid state after release; that register supplies the punchline here.
findings.replacement: Our Yeoreum had a serious case of post-nut clarity.
findings.source: 우리 여름이, 현자 타임이 제대로 왔구나.

findings.current: The black cat seemed torn between professional duty and a mother joke, but soon accepted reality.
findings.defect: “Mother joke” sounds innocuous and loses the insulting, vulgar force of 패드립.
findings.rationale: 패드립 is slang for an insult targeting someone’s parents or family, not merely a joke involving a mother.
findings.replacement: The black cat seemed torn between professional duty and the cheap shot at his mom, but soon accepted reality.
findings.source: 검은 고양이는 직업 정신과 패드립 사이에서 갈등하는 듯했지만 이내 현실을 받아들였다.

findings.current: “Unnie’s studying right now. You can’t disturb me.”
findings.defect: The untranslated Korean address is inconsistent with the surrounding natural-English rendering of Hayeon’s self-reference.
findings.rationale: 언니 is Hayeon’s playful third-person self-reference while speaking to the kitten and is naturally conveyed as “big sis” here.
findings.replacement: “Big sis is studying right now. Don’t bother me.”
findings.source: “언니 지금 공부 중이야. 방해하면 안 돼.”

findings.defect: The literal gloss is not natural English narration and leaves the physical action unnecessarily obscure.
findings.rationale: 데굴데굴 depicts Hong Woojin repeatedly rolling his body as part of covering himself in the mess.

summary: Two scene facts are mistranslated, and several localized issues alter document function, characterization, register, or natural terminology.
